newsitem.title: USA: Trump in deal for 55 Wall Street - newspaper.
newsitem.headline: Trump in deal for 55 Wall Street - newspaper.

text.p: Donald Trump has agreed to complete a $20 million deal to buy one of the historic office buildings in New York's financial district by year-end, the New York Times reported.

The newspaper said on Saturday that Trump confirmed reports in the real estate industry that he signed an agreement to buy the 1842 Greek revival office building at 55 Wall Street, which has a large ornate rotunda hall.

Trump declined to comment about his plans for the building, but officials close to him said he hoped to turn the rotunda into a restaurant, and entertainment superstore or a bank, the New York Times said.
Officials told the newspaper Trump was in discussions with House of Blues, Planet Hollywood, Hard Rock Cafe and Virgin Records and Morgan Guaranty Trust.
Trump put up 10 percent of the purchase price and signed a deal a week ago to buy the building from Commercial Development International/East, a Kajima Inc. subsidiary, the newspaper said.
Trump officials could not be reached over the weekend to comment on the story.

Trump also is expected to soon turn over Trump Castle to Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts Inc. Trump Hotels shareholders are expected to approve the $500 million acquisition of the Castle from Donald Trump at a special shareholder meeting on Monday, sources told Reuters on Friday.
